title: Retire a delegation child's cached Engram control transport when the delegation reaches a terminal state, instead of after the 5-minute idle timeout
outcome: When a delegation child (an evaluator or any read-only child) completes, fails or is cancelled, its cached per-session Engram control transport and process tree are retired promptly, rather than idling up to the control worker's 5-minute receive timeout. The stale cache entry is removed with it. Explicit deletion and project reset keep their current behaviour.
acceptance: Retire a delegation child's cached Engram control transport when the delegation reaches a terminal state, instead of after the 5-minute idle timeout is done
